question: Which deity grants protection in terrible danger at the cremation ground?
premises: Kumāra is identified as the son of six mothers.
Terrible danger can be encountered in the cremation ground.
A protective deity is invoked to ward off such danger.
inference: Therefore Kumāra is invoked to grant protection in terrible danger at the cremation ground.
uncertainties: The object of protection is implicit, but context from preceding verses suggests 'me'.
plain_english: May Kumāra, son of the six mothers, protect in terrible danger at the cremation ground.
